claims.claim: The Mâconnais had a drier season than further north. June was the exception.
Hail hit parts of Vergisson, next to Solutré. It cut yields rather than quality.
claims.quote: some hail storms to contend with as well, notably affecting parts of Vergisson

claims.claim: The crop was mostly smaller, with less juice per grape than in the north.
claims.note: Search summaries of Vinous say yields were relatively high, so sources disagree.

claims.claim: The wines have density but are not heated. Alcohol is barely above the norm. Most should reward longer cellaring.
claims.quote: not too heated in style, with alcohol degrees barely above the norm

claims.claim: A Mâconnais producer describes a wet, mild spring, early flowering, a warm summer without damaging heat spikes, and picking from late August. Acidity stayed fresh.
claims.note: One producer, one tech sheet, read through a summary.

claims.claim: Neal Martin names the dry summer as the main challenge of 2022 in the Mâconnais.

conflicts: Yields: Inside Burgundy says a smaller crop. A Vinous summary says relatively high yields, and a UK merchant guide says yields were down for a second year. Unresolved.
Spring: Talmard says wet and mild. Inside Burgundy says drier than the north, with June the exception.
gaps: No Mâconnais harvest dates from a reachable source.
Inside Burgundy and Vinous detail on whites is behind paywalls.

sheet.vintage: A dry, warm year with a smaller crop in the Mâconnais. The whites are dense but not heavy, and should keep.
